import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long numerator = 0;
        long denominator = 1;

        for (long d = 1; d <= n; d++) {
            double val = (double) x * d / y;
            long candidate = (long) val;
            if (val - (double) candidate > 0.5) {
                candidate++;
            }
            long diff1 = Math.abs(x * denominator - y * numerator);
            long diff2 = Math.abs(x * d - candidate * y);
            if ((y * d) * diff1 > (y * denominator) * diff2) {
                numerator = candidate;
                denominator = d;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
        sc.close();
    }
}
